description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Abaka AI is hiring a Member of Technical Staff, Platform to build and ship full-stack features for its Expert Talent platform. The role owns product features end-to-end, embeds AI into product workflows, and improves the performance, reliability, and observability of assessment infrastructure.
Member of Technical Staff, Platform building full-stack product features and AI workflows, plus evaluation pipelines and assessment infrastructure reliability

Responsibilities:
• Design, build, and ship full-stack product features — UI, API, and data layer — with a strong bias toward shipping and iterating quickly
• Own features end-to-end, from product discussion through implementation, testing, and release
• Embed AI directly into product workflows: AI-powered features, assistive UX, and automation that make the product feel intelligent, not just functional
• Build evaluation pipelines and data models for AI-powered features
• Leverage modern AI coding tools to accelerate development while maintaining a high engineering bar
• Partner closely with Product and Design to shape scope and UX, not just implement a spec handed to you
• Improve the performance, reliability, and observability of assessment infrastructure

Requirements:
• 1+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production features
• Strong backend fundamentals: API design, data modeling, distributed systems, and relational databases
• Comfortable working across the stack, including modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React/TypeScript) when the product needs it
• Knowledge in building AI Agents into productinos
• Product-minded: you ask "why should we build this" and "is this the right solution" as naturally as "how do I build this," and you treat customer outcomes as the measure of success, not the technology you shipped
• AI-native by default: you already use AI coding tools daily, and you've built or shipped features that use LLMs/AI
• Solid engineering fundamentals: testing, debugging, performance basics, and the judgment to know when to invest in each
• Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving priorities
• High ownership, pragmatism, and a bias toward shipping

Preferred:
• Experience building or integrating LLM-powered features in production is a strong plus
• Startup or founder experience
• Experience building consumer-facing products at scale
• ML and Deep Learning knowledge and experience
• Experience with microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
